spec.description: Fetch the largest item id yet assigned.

response.description: The current largest item id. Walk backwards from it to see everything the site has.

unverified.detail: Written from the Hacker News API documentation and the live endpoint's own shape, with no recording committed yet. The Record workflow replays `examples/*.request.json` through a client generated from this spec and fills in the responses.

notes: The body is a bare JSON number, not an object. A recording of it is a single integer, and the value moves every few seconds: an example records the id at one moment, and the mock replays that.
